_about: University lists that name student organizations for a goal, a college or a subject (DESIGN 2.1, 2.6). Facts only: each list's title, link, dates and the organization names exactly as the page prints them. Never the pages' own descriptions, and never the group email addresses the pre-law page shows. Names are joined to OneIllinois ids in aliases.json, by hand. A list counts as one thing: `goal` (a CAREER_TRACKS or INTEREST_TOPICS id), `college` (a programs.json college code) or `subject` (a course prefix). `short` is the phrase the rail's why-line uses: 'On {short}' for a goal list, 'Listed by {short}' for a college or subject list. Re-read on the dates in `refresh`; tag.mjs prints every name that has no directory id on each run.
